text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

words.gloss_range: conjunction opening a continued speech beat; linkage and launch are both locally possible
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens as a speech-link: it carries the previous response forward while launching a fresh rhetorical beat. The payoff is continuity, so the reader hears 5:84 as continued direct speech rather than a detached maxim.

topics.headline: continued speech launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as continued direct speech rather than as a detached new statement.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction can coordinate or resume, and the boundary rows make the direct-speech continuation the local payoff.

words.gloss_range: interrogative particle in the rhetorical nominal frame, not the later relative pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the interrogative member of the repeated surface pair. Here it forms the rhetorical “what is with us” opening, pressing commitment rather than seeking information, while the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) will become the relative content believed. Its compact a-vowel cadence also delays the heavier belief verb.

topics.headline: rhetorical self-question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question form presses an affirmed commitment rather than asking for missing information.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as interrogative and subject of the nominal clause; the CRITICAL rows coherently read the formula as rhetorical.

topics.headline: question versus relative ma
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surface form later returns with a different function, separating the question from the received content.
topics.reason: QAC distinguishes word 2 as interrogative and word 9 as relative, supporting the CRITICAL contrast.

topics.headline: compact a-cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening particles as a compact cadence before the heavier belief verb arrives.
topics.reason: The phonetic row gives a modest but concrete sound payoff in the opening formula.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus first-person plural suffix; dative self-concern in the rhetorical question
words.prose: {{ar:لَنَا}} ({{tr:lanā}}) turns the question inward. The preposition-plus-suffix makes the issue a matter for the speakers themselves, and the same plural “us” carries the recognized group across the boundary from 5:83.

topics.headline: speaker group carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same first-person plural group carried from recognition into self-questioning.
topics.reason: The attached suffix is morphologically present and boundary rows tie it to the prior speaker group.

topics.headline: inward dative concern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is framed as what is with or for us, turning the issue inward before the negated verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the prepositional predicate relation and QAC identifies dative of interest.

words.gloss_range: negative particle before the imperfect; negation is folded into a rhetorical affirmation frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) places non-belief inside the question as the state under examination. Because the frame is rhetorical, the negation is not neutral denial; it makes “not believing” sound impossible for these speakers after what has come to them. The run of light particles before the main verb tightens that opening question.

topics.headline: negation inside affirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that not believing is posed as an impossible self-description, so negation becomes the route to commitment.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negating the imperfect, while the larger rhetorical frame reverses that denial into affirmation.

topics.headline: light particles before verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a run of short particles that delays the main belief verb and tightens the opening question.
topics.reason: The echo row adds a concrete sound-and-sequence payoff without changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: Form IV first-person plural imperfect belief/trust directed by the following prepositional complements
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and belief remain in the root range, while the local Form IV verb selects active believing/trusting
words.prose: {{ar:نُؤْمِنُ}} ({{tr:nuʾminu}}) gives the first main stance as ongoing first-person plural belief. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field adds trust and security pressure, but local Form IV grammar keeps the active sense as believing or trusting in the governed objects: God and what came from the truth. It also turns the 5:83 belief declaration into a question-shaped commitment, sets the ayah’s beginning-middle-end line of belief, truth, and righteousness, and its internal hamza gives the first main verb an audible catch.

topics.headline: ongoing plural belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as an ongoing first-person plural stance, not only a past confession.
topics.reason: The imperfect indicative and first-person plural agreement are explicit in QAC and attachment evidence.

topics.headline: trust and safety field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief carries trust and security pressure, while the local Form IV verb still selects believing in God and what came from the truth.
topics.reason: The root family supports trust/safety associations, but local grammar and Form IV object structure keep the sense within active belief/trust.

topics.headline: belief tied to God, truth, and righteousness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief at the ayah opening joined to God as object, truth as evidence, and righteousness as the final communal destination.
topics.reason: The local complement structure and row-level collocations connect the verb to both belief objects and to the ayah-wide axis.

topics.headline: belief declaration returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior declaration in 5:83 returns here as an ongoing question-shaped commitment.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete Surah 5 references and the local imperfect form supports the shift from prior declaration to ongoing stance.

topics.headline: hamza break in belief verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an internal catch inside the belief verb, giving the first main verb audible weight.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is modest but locally tied to the surface form.

words.gloss_range: preposition that directs belief toward its governed object and binds the complement structure
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) prevents belief from floating as an abstraction. It fastens the belief verb to its object, first the divine name and then the coordinated relative content, and its proclitic shape makes the connector visibly fuse to the following name.

topics.headline: belief receives an object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is not left abstract; the preposition fastens it to its object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both make the preposition govern the belief complement structure.

topics.headline: clitic fused to divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small connector visually and grammatically fused to the divine name that follows.
topics.reason: The proclitic form supports the formal payoff without creating a new lexical branch.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in the genitive under bi, the definite object of belief
words.root_gloss_range: deity/worship associations remain backgrounded by the proper-name form, which fixes the referent locally
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is the definite proper-name object of belief under the preceding preposition. Root-level deity and worship associations remain backgrounded by the proper-name form, while the ayah later shifts from God as trust object to the Lord-title as the agent of admission. The same belief-in-God formula is visible within Surah 5 (5:81; 5:83), and the preceding preposition runs audibly into the name at the trust object.

topics.headline: proper name as trust object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first object of belief is the definite divine proper name, governed by the preceding preposition.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the proper noun as genitive under the preposition, and attachment fixes it as complement of the belief verb.

topics.headline: deity field fixed by proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship/deity associations behind the name, while the local proper-name form fixes the referent rather than opening generic deity language.
topics.reason: Root-level discussion may remain as background, but QAC and V4 local observation identify the surface as a proper noun.

topics.headline: Allāh then Rabb roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a role split inside the ayah: God is named first as the object of trust, then Lord as the agent of hoped admission.
topics.reason: The local grammar separates the governed belief object from the later nominative subject of admission.

topics.headline: belief formula parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that believing in God is part of a familiar formula also visible within Surah 5 (5:81; 5:83).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references and are consistent with the local prepositional belief construction.

topics.headline: bi-Allāh liaison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition and name run together at the trust object.
topics.reason: The sound row is surface-bound and does not alter grammar.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the divine object of belief to the received truth-clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second belief object to the first. The reader sees belief directed not only toward God but also toward what has concretely come from the truth, with the repeated conjunctions segmenting the ayah into belief, evidence, and aspiration.

topics.headline: second object joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is directed both to God and to what has come from the truth, not to a free-floating claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the second coordinated complement structure after the belief verb.

topics.headline: bridge to arrived truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah move from the divine name to the concrete arrival of truth.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the divine object and relative arrival clause as a single belief complex.

topics.headline: three-beat segmentation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated conjunctions dividing the ayah into belief, evidence, and aspiration beats.
topics.reason: The row’s segmentation matches the local sequence of conjunctions and clauses.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun heading the content that came to the speakers
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is now relative, not interrogative. It leaves the received content broad for a moment, then the following phrase specifies it as what has come from the truth.

topics.headline: relative content clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this form now heads the content believed, not the question asked.
topics.reason: QAC identifies word 9 as a relative pronoun introducing the arrival clause.

topics.headline: broad received what
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the received content stays broad until the following phrase specifies it as from the truth.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is unspecified while the following prepositional phrase gives the truth-source/category.

words.gloss_range: perfect arrival verb with attached first-person plural object; the truth has already reached them
words.root_gloss_range: coming/arrival is active locally, with physical arrival imagery narrowed to revelation reception
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَنَا}} ({{tr:jāʾanā}}) makes the evidence completed and recipient-facing: it has come to us. The arrival image is concrete, but the local truth phrase narrows that motion into revelation reception rather than ordinary travel. The verb and truth noun form the evidence beat, moving from recognized truth in 5:83 to arrived truth in 5:84, and the long vowel plus hamza slow the word at that point.

topics.headline: completed arrival to us
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the truth has already reached the speakers, with them marked directly by the attached suffix.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect verb with attached object pronoun, and attachment identifies the suffix as object.

topics.headline: truth cast as arriver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truth pictured as something that comes to them, while local context narrows physical arrival into revelation reception.
topics.reason: The arrival root and perfect form support concrete motion imagery, but the governed truth phrase keeps the local referent revelatory.

topics.headline: arrival of truth pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the arrival verb and truth noun forming the evidence beat that answers earlier recognition.
topics.reason: The verb governs the truth phrase and the row-level echoes are consistent with the local evidence clause.

topics.headline: recognized then arrived truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from recognizing truth in 5:83 to naming it as what has come in 5:84.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete boundary relation and the local perfect arrival verb carries it.

topics.headline: long arrival sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the long vowel and hamza slow the arrival verb at the evidence point.
topics.reason: The sound payoff is tied to the local surface form.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the definite truth noun, allowing source, partitive, or explanatory force
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) completes the arrival clause by governing the truth phrase. Its source, partitive, and explanatory possibilities all matter because the speakers ground belief in what came from, or as part of, the truth. The same phrase also closes the evidence beat and bridges the recognized truth from 5:83 into this claim.

topics.headline: source or specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the truth phrase can work as source, part, or specification, while the local clause only needs it to complete what came to them.
topics.reason: QAC allows partitive/source function and attachment fixes the genitive complement after the arrival verb.

topics.headline: truth phrase bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prepositional phrase closes the arrival clause and bridges the recognized truth across the boundary.
topics.reason: The phrase is syntactically required after the arrival verb and boundary rows tie it to the prior ayah.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun in the genitive; truth as established reality/right in the arrival clause
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, right, due, and firmness are in range, narrowed locally to the recognized truth that has come
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) closes the evidence beat as an identifiable truth. The {{ar:ح ق ق}} ({{tr:ḥ-q-q}}) range brings truth, reality, right, due, and firmness, narrowed locally to the established truth that has reached them; it also carries the boundary from recognized truth in 5:83 to arrived truth in 5:84. The arrived-truth formula keeps Surah 5 echoes such as 5:77 and 5:48 in view, and the guttural texture gives the evidence beat a firm close.

topics.headline: definite established truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices truth as an identifiable, stable reality that has reached the speakers.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite gerund under the preposition, and root evidence supports firmness/establishment in the truth noun.

topics.headline: truth, right, and due range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word carries truth, reality, right, and due, while the arrival clause selects the recognized truth as evidence.
topics.reason: The broad root range is valid but must be limited by the local definite truth phrase after the arrival verb.

topics.headline: truth-arrival formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that arrived truth is a recognizable Quranic formula, with Surah 5 echoes such as 5:77 and 5:48 in the background.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete formula and Surah 5 references, and the local phrase matches the arrival-of-truth construction.

topics.headline: truth returns from recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word returning from 5:83, now shifted from recognized truth to claimed arrived truth.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give the concrete 5:83 to 5:84 shift and the local definite noun preserves it.

topics.headline: firm guttural close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the evidence beat close on a firm guttural texture.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally bound to the final word of the evidence phrase.

words.gloss_range: conjunction or circumstantial connector moving from evidence to aspiration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns evidence into aspiration. It can be heard as coordination and circumstance together: after truth has come, the speakers’ hope for admission interprets that reception as a claim of belonging. Against the Surah 5 warning about excess around truth (5:77), this turn makes the response aspiration rather than deviation.

topics.headline: coordination with circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hope clause both continues the sentence and interprets the received truth as belonging-oriented.
topics.reason: QAC allows coordination or circumstantial force, and attachment strongly licenses coordination with the prior predicate.

topics.headline: evidence to request turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from what came to them into what they hope their Lord will do.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the final coordinated verbal clause, and synthesis rows identify the evidence-to-request movement.

topics.headline: truth excess contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a Surah 5 contrast: after truth has come, the response here is aspiration rather than excess or deviation (5:77).
topics.reason: The rows supply the concrete 5:77 comparison and the local conjunction creates the transition.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural imperfect desire/hope selecting an an-clause as its goal
words.root_gloss_range: hope and covetous desire are both in the root range, but the righteous object revalues the local desire as hopeful aspiration
words.prose: {{ar:نَطْمَعُ}} ({{tr:naṭmaʿu}}) opens the final beat as ongoing plural aspiration. The {{ar:ط م ع}} ({{tr:ṭ-m-ʿ}}) range can include charged desire, but the governed goal, admission with the righteous, revalues it here as hopeful longing rather than greed. That hope is immediately paired with entry, recalls hoping-to-enter scenes such as 26:51, 7:46, and 70:38, carries recognition forward into reward expectation, and the emphatic consonant gives the desire a pressed sound.

topics.headline: ongoing governed aspiration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices desire as an ongoing plural act that points forward to a specific subordinate goal.
topics.reason: QAC marks the imperfect first-person plural verb and attachment forces the following an-clause as complement.

topics.headline: desire revalued by object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the morally charged desire root, while the requested admission with the righteous makes the local force hopeful rather than greedy.
topics.reason: The root range includes hope and covetous desire, but the an-clause and righteous-company object constrain the local reading.

topics.headline: hope paired with entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hope immediately paired with divine admission, making desire a request for entry into company.
topics.reason: The local complement structure links the desire verb to the admission verb and accompaniment phrase.

topics.headline: aspiration formula parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this hope formula alongside other Quranic hoping-to-enter scenes, including 26:51, 7:46, and 70:38.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references and the local naṭmaʿu an construction supports the comparison.

topics.headline: pressed desire sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the emphatic consonant give the desire verb a pressed texture.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the local surface.

topics.headline: recognition overflows into hope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recognition becoming forward reward expectation rather than stopping at assent.
topics.reason: The transition rows match the local move from evidence clause to desire clause.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive particle that turns desire into a governed admission-goal
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) makes the hope precise. It subordinates the admission clause under the desire verb, so aspiration is immediately aimed at divine action rather than left vague.

topics.headline: desire made precise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that aspiration is not vague; the particle turns it into the precise goal of admission.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as governing the subjunctive, and attachment makes the following clause the content of desire.

words.gloss_range: Form IV subjunctive causative admission with the speakers as object
words.root_gloss_range: entering/admission is active locally as caused entry into company, not self-entry or bare physical motion
words.prose: {{ar:يُدْخِلَنَا}} ({{tr:yudkhilanā}}) is causative and subjunctive: the speakers hope to be admitted, not to enter by themselves. The entry image is narrowed by the following with-the-people phrase into communal inclusion rather than entry into a place, and the attached “us” remains the patient of that divine action. This concentrates agency in their Lord, joins Surah 5’s entry arc from promised or resisted entry to desired admission (5:12; 5:22-24), carries the petitioning group toward the answer in 5:85, and the verb’s stops sound before the Lord-title supplies the agent.

topics.headline: causative admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers do not enter by themselves; they hope to be admitted by another agent.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form IV causative and the object suffix; attachment identifies the later Lord-title as subject.

topics.headline: subjunctive hoped admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices admission as hoped-for and unrealized, not as a completed event.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as subjunctive under an, matching the aspiration frame.

topics.headline: entry becomes communal inclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees physical entry imagery redirected toward communal inclusion with the righteous.
topics.reason: The d-kh-l root supports entry, but the maʿa community phrase narrows the object to accompaniment with a people rather than a place.

topics.headline: agency belongs to Rabbunā
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the action transferred from the speakers’ hope to their Lord’s agency.
topics.reason: The verb carries the speakers as object and the explicit subject follows as Rabbunā.

topics.headline: Surah 5 entry arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Surah 5’s entry motif shift from promised or resisted entry to desired admission with a righteous company (5:12; 5:22-24).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete Surah 5 entry references and the local admission verb fits the motif.

topics.headline: petitioning group answered forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same object suffix carrying the petitioning group toward the next ayah’s answer.
topics.reason: The attached object suffix continues the speaker group and boundary rows connect the hope to 5:85.

topics.headline: stopped entry sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears stops in the admission verb before the Lord-title supplies the agent.
topics.reason: The phonetic row remains local to the surface sequence.

words.gloss_range: possessive Lord-title as explicit nominative subject of the admission verb
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, nurture, and sustaining authority remain in range, locally naming the speakers’ own Lord as agent
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}) supplies the explicit subject after the admission verb. The possessive title makes the hoped agency personal: their own Lord, with nurturing authority, is the one expected to admit them. This distinguishes God as belief object from Lord as admission-agent, reverses Surah 5’s earlier entry refusal scenes (5:21; 5:22-24), shifts the Lord-title from address in 5:83 to agency in 5:84, prepares God’s reward action in 5:85, and the doubled consonant compresses the title after the longer admission verb.

topics.headline: our Lord as explicit subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speakers’ own Lord named explicitly as the one hoped to admit them.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as nominative and definite by suffix; attachment forces it as the subject of yudkhila.

topics.headline: nurturing lordship as agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lordship as nurturing authority behind admission, while the local clause keeps it focused on agency rather than abstract lordship.
topics.reason: The root field supports care and lordship, and the local nominative role makes that field agency-bearing.

topics.headline: Allāh object, Rabb agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names God as the belief object and our Lord as the personal agent of admission.
topics.reason: The two divine references occupy different grammatical roles in the ayah.

topics.headline: entry refusal reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Surah 5’s earlier entry refusal reversed as a desire for the Lord’s admission (5:21; 5:22-24).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete Surah 5 entry scenes and the local Rabb-plus-entry pairing supports the contrast.

topics.headline: address becomes attribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Lord-title shift from direct address in 5:83 to third-person attribution of agency in 5:84.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give the concrete 5:83 to 5:84 grammatical shift.

topics.headline: Lord agency answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hoped Lord-agency in 5:84 answered by God’s reward action in 5:85.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies the concrete forward uptake and the local subject role sets it up.

topics.headline: compressed Lord-title sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled consonant concentrate the Lord-title after the longer admission verb.
topics.reason: The phonetic payoff is surface-specific and does not alter the grammar.

words.gloss_range: adverbial preposition governing the following genitive community phrase; with/among as companionship
words.root_gloss_range: companionship and co-presence are active locally, narrowed to communal inclusion rather than mere nearness
words.prose: {{ar:مَعَ}} ({{tr:maʿa}}) defines the endpoint of admission as company. It governs the following genitive community phrase, so the request is not bare nearness but shared belonging with the righteous, echoing the with-phrase of 5:83. Accompaniment itself becomes a marked endpoint, and a light nasal link carries the particle into the community noun.

topics.headline: company phrase governed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small word requires the following genitive community phrase to complete the destination of admission.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify maʿa as governing the following genitive phrase.

topics.headline: with as communal inclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the request is for shared company and status, not mere proximity beside the righteous.
topics.reason: The accompaniment semantics survive, while the admission clause narrows them to communal inclusion.

topics.headline: admission endpoint defined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that admission is defined by being with a named people rather than entering an unnamed place.
topics.reason: The adverbial phrase attached to the admission verb supplies the endpoint relation.

topics.headline: with-phrase repetition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated with-construction linking being written with witnesses in 5:83 to being admitted with the righteous in 5:84.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete 5:83-5:84 repetition and the local phrase preserves the shared construction.

topics.headline: marked companionship endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices accompaniment itself as a marked endpoint in the request.
topics.reason: The rare-root row is retained as a local markedness payoff, constrained to the maʿa companionship mechanism.

topics.headline: nasal link to qawm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a light nasal link from the accompaniment particle into the community noun.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is surface-local and modest.

words.gloss_range: definite concrete collective in the genitive under maʿa, specified by the following adjective
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, and peoplehood remain in range, locally realized as a definite community
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمِ}} ({{tr:al-qawmi}}) names the destination as a definite community. The following adjective locks the moral value onto the people, while the {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) standing-collective pressure remains narrowed to a concrete group rather than an etymological claim. Surah 5’s often threatening people-language is revalued here as the desired righteous community, and the community noun plus righteous adjective form one righteous-community pair.

topics.headline: definite governed community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a definite community as the genitive complement of with, forming the ayah’s landing phrase.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment fix al-qawm as the governed genitive complement and the rows show its definite destination role.

topics.headline: righteous adjective locked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are defined by the following righteous adjective, not left as an unspecified group.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies the adjective relation and agreement, locking ṣāliḥīn to al-qawm.

topics.headline: standing collective image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the desired people as a standing collective, while local usage keeps the sense as community rather than etymological argument.
topics.reason: The q-w-m root allows standing/rising pressure, but the local noun functions as a concrete collective people.

topics.headline: qawm revalued in Surah 5
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Surah 5’s often threatening qawm language revalued here as the desired righteous community.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete Surah 5 valence movement, and the local modifier supplies the positive revaluation.

topics.headline: community and soundness paired
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the community noun and righteous adjective forming one righteous-community pair.
topics.reason: The local adjective relation activates the q-w-m plus ṣ-l-ḥ pairing.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle modifying the community noun
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, fitness, repair, and righteousness remain in range, locally realized as the defining quality of the desired people
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥīna}}) seals the ayah by defining the desired company. As a definite plural active participle, it presents righteousness as an ongoing communal quality, with the {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) field of soundness, fitness, wholeness, repair, and resistance to corruption gathered into the final class-title. The word reunites the belief-and-righteousness pairing across the ayah, links the hoped company with righteous figures and righteous-deeds language (3:39; 5:9; 5:69), closes on a plural community sound, and prepares the doers-of-good reward class in 5:85.

topics.headline: definite righteous class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word defining the desired people as the known righteous class.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark the word as a definite plural active participle adjective modifying al-qawm.

topics.headline: active ongoing soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteousness as an active ongoing quality, not merely a past achievement.
topics.reason: The active participle form supports ongoing quality in the final adjective.

topics.headline: sound, fit, and whole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteousness as soundness, fitness, wholeness, and resistance to corruption, while local syntax keeps it as the people’s defining adjective.
topics.reason: The broad ṣ-l-ḥ field is valid, but the local active participle adjective narrows it to the quality of the community.

topics.headline: belief and righteousness reunited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the common belief-and-righteousness pairing redistributed across the ayah: belief near the beginning and righteous identity at the end.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local opening belief verb and final ṣāliḥīn word into a structural dyad.

topics.headline: righteous company echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the requested company linked with established righteous figures and Surah 5 righteous-deeds language, including 3:39, 5:9, and 5:69.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references and the local final class-title supports the echo.

topics.headline: plural closing sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on a plural ending, so the aspiration lands on a community rather than one figure.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is tied to the final masculine plural surface.

topics.headline: righteous closure answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the righteous-company closure in 5:84 preparing the rewarded doers-of-good class in 5:85.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the concrete forward uptake from final righteous company to the next ayah’s rewarded class.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نُؤْمِنُ / جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ / نَطْمَعُ / يُدْخِلَنَا ... مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth reaches the speakers as a stable reality, settles into assent, and draws hope toward Lord-caused entry into a sound human collective. The focus moves from reception through inward trust to social belonging.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the speakers' receptive commitment.
Ordinary coming supplies the incoming motion by which truth reaches them.
Reality fixed against falsehood makes the received content a stable criterion.
The heart's hope supplies the forward pull from assent toward inclusion.
Passage into an interior makes inclusion a real boundary crossing caused by the Lord.
A human collective supplies the social body into which entry is desired.
Soundness against corruption characterizes the desired collective.

changed_reading.before: A declaration of belief followed by a hope for reward.
changed_reading.after: A causal trajectory in which received truth becomes settled assent and then a petition for divinely effected membership among people marked by soundness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْحَقِّ / نُؤْمِنُ / نَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers act as subjects of believing but not as agents of admission. Certainty about truth coexists with hopeful dependence on the sovereign Lord for belonging, so epistemic confidence does not become self-certification.

activation_trace.role: Fixed reality supports confidence about what has been received.
Settled assent is an action the speakers can presently own.
Hope keeps the desired admission from being stated as a possessed entitlement.
Causative entry places the decisive transition in another agent's power.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the agent authorized to grant admission.
The collective remains a body one must be placed with rather than merely claim.

changed_reading.before: Belief and salvation are one continuous assertion of certainty.
changed_reading.after: The verse preserves an asymmetry: the speakers confidently assent to truth while humbly leaving communal and salvific admission to their Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus reverses the transit pattern of 5:61. There, claimants come, say they believe, enter carrying veiled truth, and leave unchanged; here, truth comes to the speakers, they genuinely assent, and they ask the Lord to cause a new entry among the sound.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary arrival starts the counterfeit sequence with the claimants as the moving subject.
Settled assent is the inward reality their spoken faith claim purports to have.
Inward corruption makes their entry capable of carrying concealed unbelief.
Veiling the truth names the cargo that survives their passage.
Movement outward completes a transit that produced no inward change.
The moving subject is now truth itself, which arrives at receptive speakers.
Heart-settling assent supplies the genuine inward change missing from 5:61.
Lord-caused entry redirects movement toward a sound collective rather than through concealed unbelief.

structural_cues: 5:61 orders coming, a faith claim, entry with unbelief, and exit while retaining it.
5:84 orders belief, truth's arrival, and hoped-for Lord-caused entry.
The repeated roots change both the moving subject and what is carried inward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored coming, believing, and entering vocabulary plus opposed inward contents; I infer a deliberate reversal of permeability and agency. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between sincere and insincere groups without a designed lexical mirror.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely state that their belief is sincere.
changed_reading.after: Their confession enacts the inverse of counterfeit faith: truth penetrates them, changes assent, and redirects entry toward a sound communal interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hope in 5:84 occupies an announced faith-to-admission pattern. Verse 5:65 states the conditional admission of believing People of the Book into gardens, 5:69 joins belief to sound action, and 5:85 immediately returns the speakers' response to them as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the antecedent of the earlier conditional promise.
Causative passage inside supplies the promised consequence later hoped for in the focus.
A garden enclosed by vegetation gives the promised admission a concrete destination.
Suitability and fitness connect belief to action that fits its proper purpose.
Heart-hope voices the conditional promise from the position of new claimants.
The focus repeats the promised boundary crossing as a petition.
Recompense returning to its actor turns the preceding confession into consequential response.
Action met by its corresponding return closes the conditional pattern.
Doing what is good identifies the rewarded class without equating its label mechanically with صالحين.

structural_cues: 5:65 uses a counterfactual faith clause followed by divine causative admission into gardens.
5:69 links belief with صالح action, while 5:84 turns صالح into desired company.
5:85 follows the focus with reward explicitly tied to what the speakers said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated faith and admission roots, the صالح bridge, and immediate reward; I infer that 5:84 self-locates inside the earlier conditional and 5:85 narratively closes it. A live alternative is that 5:65 addresses a distinct hypothetical group and 5:85 supplies only a general afterlife outcome.

changed_reading.before: Their admission is a free-floating and uncertain wish.
changed_reading.after: Their hope is informed by an earlier conditional promise and is immediately narrated as receiving its corresponding return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus compresses a repaired reception system. Desire had filtered unwelcome arrival, and repeated blindness and deafness had sealed perception; in 5:83 hearing becomes understanding, recognition discriminates truth, affect overflows, and assent settles.

activation_trace.role: The soul's inclination supplies the earlier filter that rejects what does not suit desire.
Blindness of inward perception supplies repeated failure to recognize meaning.
Loss of hearing and refusal to listen supply repeated closure to received speech.
Hearing as understanding and compliance reopens reception at its first stage.
Expansion from fullness makes tears the outward excess of an inwardly saturated response.
Recognition by a distinguishing sign supplies the cognitive discrimination of truth.
Reality fixed against falsehood is what reopened perception recognizes.
Settled assent is the articulated result of hearing, affect, and recognition.
Arrival anchors this sensory-cognitive sequence in what has reached the focus speakers.
Stable truth is the focus object recognized through the reopened channel.
Heart-settling assent names the focus outcome of repaired reception.

structural_cues: 5:70 opposes incoming revelation to what souls desire.
5:71 repeats the paired sequence of blindness and deafness twice.
5:83 sequences hearing, visible overflow, recognition of truth, and confession of belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies closure, reopened senses, recognition, tears, and assent; I infer a functional reception pipeline rather than treating each as an isolated motif. A live alternative is that tears attest emotion only and that the sensory contrast is rhetorical rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: What came to them is simply information they accepted.
changed_reading.after: The phrase names the endpoint of restored permeability: revelation is heard, affectively registered, recognized as truth, and only then confessed as settled belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent requests form a two-stage identity transition: first place the speakers' names in the witness register, then have the Lord bring them into lived company with a fitting collective. Public attestation and actual incorporation are related but not collapsed.

activation_trace.role: Entering a name in a register or class supplies formal recognition of identity.
Presence with direct witnessing defines the class into whose record they first ask to be placed.
Actual passage inside advances beyond recorded classification to incorporation.
Sovereign lordship authorizes the transition that a register alone cannot effect.
A concrete human collective supplies the social destination of incorporation.
Fitness and suitability define the qualifying character of that destination.

structural_cues: 5:83 and 5:84 are adjacent first-person plural petitions.
Both petitions use a placement verb followed by مَعَ and a qualified human class.
The agent shifts from requested inscription to Lord-caused entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent register and entry images plus parallel with-constructions; I infer sequential public recognition and incorporation. A live alternative is that the two petitions are synonymous descriptions of one eschatological acceptance.

changed_reading.before: Admission means private reward or simple co-location with good people.
changed_reading.after: Admission completes an identity transfer that begins with public enrollment among witnesses and culminates in Lord-authorized incorporation among the fit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated corrupt patronage is replaced by a different geometry of relation. Mocking allies and unbelieving loyalties give way to nearness, affection, and absence of dominance, after which the speakers seek durable company with a relation-repairing people.

activation_trace.role: Mockery supplies the degrading relation practiced by prohibited allies.
Purposeless play supplies the allies' refusal of serious shared commitment.
Love, support, and alliance define the social bond whose misuse begins the pericope.
The same alliance image is made incompatible with genuine belief near the focus.
Nearness against distance supplies the new relational geometry.
Affection supplies the positive bond that replaces hostile or mocking patronage.
Overbearing contest and domination clarify what the negated arrogance removes from the new bond.
A human collective gives the reordered relation a durable social body.
Removal of estrangement makes the desired people a relation-repairing community.

structural_cues: 5:57 forbids taking as allies those who turn religion into mockery and play.
5:80-81 again connect unbelief with misdirected alliance.
5:82 pivots from strongest hostility to nearest affection immediately before the focus request to be with another group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained sequence of alliance, proximity, affection, and non-dominance; I infer that مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ marks a transfer of affiliation. A live alternative is that مع refers only to future co-location and does not revise present social loyalties.

changed_reading.before: The speakers hope simply to join morally good people.
changed_reading.after: They seek a Lord-authorized transfer from degrading patronage structures into a near, affectionate, and relation-repairing communal bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 5:77 turns truth and people into a navigation problem: following desire-led people produces repeated straying from a level path. In the focus, received truth becomes the reference line and the صالح people become an embodied alignment with it.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion religion must not exceed.
Following behind supplies the directional dependence by which a group sets one's course.
Inclination of the self supplies the unstable guide opposed to truth.
A human collective carries and propagates the desire-led trajectory.
Repeated loss of guidance supplies the result of following the wrong collective.
Straightness and completed balance supply the path's reference geometry.
An extended traversable road makes alignment a continuing course rather than one decision.
The arrived truth supplies the stable reference the speakers now accept.
Uprightness, balance, and straight standing turn the desired people into an embodied path alignment.
Fitness for purpose makes that collective congruent with the truth-reference.

structural_cues: 5:77 places truth, following, desire, a people, repeated straying, and the level path in one sequence.
5:84 repeats truth and a people but changes the desired relation from following desire to being placed with the fit.
The focus collective can therefore function as a lived orientation, not merely a demographic label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, following, desire, straying, truth, and upright or fitting group images; I infer that communal belonging embodies epistemic alignment. A live alternative is that the path language and the focus's social request remain separate moral descriptions.

changed_reading.before: Truth is a proposition and the صالح people are an unrelated reward-company.
changed_reading.after: Truth is also an orienting measure, while company with the صالح people is the social form of staying aligned to that measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material joint, interpenetration, and support branches in an ordinary moral-social sentence. It remains anchored in ٱلْحَقِّ, يُدْخِلَنَا, ٱلْقَوْمِ, and ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ, whose packet branches jointly support a fit-assembly analogy. Downstream prose should present it only as a structural analogy, not as a lexical translation or claim that the people are literally machine parts.

activation_trace.role: A right that matches its joint or receptacle supplies precise structural correspondence.
Interpenetrating parts supply the image of incorporation into an articulated whole.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative work that makes a part ready to fit.
Support and sustaining structure make the collective a load-bearing body.
Suitability for a thing supplies the exact fit by which incorporation becomes functional.

changed_reading.before: Admission places an unchanged individual beside morally good people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, lordly formation makes the speakers fitting parts of a coherent, load-bearing social body rather than merely adjacent occupants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recruits remote water branches of coming, entry, and lordly imagery. It remains worth carrying because the focus supplies arrival and admission while 5:83 supplies overflow and a filled tear-vessel and 5:85 supplies running rivers. Downstream prose should qualify it as a hydraulic analogy of receptivity and circulation, never as a claim that truth is literally water or that these focus verbs bear water senses here.

activation_trace.role: Water collecting in a depression supplies an exploratory image for truth arriving and gathering in receptive subjects.
Bringing thirsty animals back into watering supplies an exploratory image of admission into replenishing flow.
Layered rain-cloud imagery gives the nurturing Lord a remote provision role in the analogy.
Easy abundant overflow makes inward recognition visibly exceed its container.
A vessel filled until it spills gives tears the role of saturation evidence.
Continuous flowing extends reception into sustained circulation at the promised destination.
A river cutting a course through land gives the final flow a durable channel.

changed_reading.before: Truth is accepted cognitively and admission is a static placement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, received truth fills receptive persons until response overflows, and admission places them within a sustained current of provision.

strongest_changes: The 5:61 mirror turns the focus into a reversal of counterfeit transit: people once arrived carrying concealed unbelief, whereas truth now arrives and the Lord is asked to effect genuine entry.
Verses 5:65, 5:69, and 5:85 make the hope an enacted conditional pattern, moving from promised admission through fitting response to returned recompense.
The 5:71 and 5:83 contrast recasts belief as reopened reception: blindness and deafness give way to hearing, recognition, affective overflow, and settled assent.
The alliance and registration sequences make being with the صالح people a transfer of affiliation and publicly recognized identity, not bare co-location.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's densest activation was directional: who or what comes, what enters with whom, and who authorizes belonging. Immediate context also linked cognition, affect, witness, social proximity, and admission while allowing those mechanisms to remain distinct.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains open whether admission chiefly names the gardens confirmed in 5:85, present communal incorporation, or both.
The register-to-admission sequence may be a deliberate two-stage transition or two adjacent descriptions of one acceptance.
صالحين and محسنين are functionally connected by the reward sequence but are not lexically identical classes.
The jointed-body and hydraulic readings are branch-led analogies and should remain secondary.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hope directs recognition toward communal entry.** `ط م ع B001` is heartfelt hope, `د خ ل B005` an entrant mixed into a group, and `ص ل ح B002` reconciliation. Truth's arrival generates desire not for private possession but incorporation among a repaired people. I infer that belief seeks a social body in which recognition can operate.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hope pulls recognition toward communal entry.** Fixed **ط م ع / B001** (“heartfelt desire and hope”) supplies the forward attraction, and fixed **د خ ل / B001** supplies its desired boundary crossing. 5:83 moves from recognized truth to witness; 5:85 realizes entry into gardens, while 5:86 contrasts companionship with blaze. I infer that hope converts assent into a request for placement among a sound people. The ayah reads belief as movement toward a moral company, not only acceptance of incoming information.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:85 realized the hoped-for entry, while 5:86’s opposing companionship showed that response to truth sorts agents into durable companies.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.

Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınma eylemini ve bu eylemin yöneldiği varlığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tapınma eylemini veya kendini tapınmaya vermesini bildiren eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem olarak tapınma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun kendisine tapındığı varlık veya nesneden söz edilen ad bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmanın yöneldiği varlık veya nesne anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın başkalarına tapınma konusu olarak benimsetilmesini anlatan ettirgen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı tapınma konusu durumuna getirme işlemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tapınmayı korku, inziva veya aşırı uygulama koşuluna bağlamaz ve tapınılan varlığı da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Korkudan doğan, inziva veya ek yüklenme biçimindeki özel bir tapınma yaşayışını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesi bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genel tapınma eylemini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılmayı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Özel ad, tapınılan yüce varlık düşüncesi üzerinden bu dalın varlık anlamıyla bağlantılıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel anlam örgüsünü verir; komşu dal ise o örgüden türemiş özel adı ve adın belirli söz kalıplarındaki kullanımını ayrı bir biçim alanı olarak sınırlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Tapınma eylemi, korkuya bağlı özel tapınma yaşayışı ve aynı kökün özel ad dalı sınırı keskinleştirdi; peygamberlik, büyücülük, belirli tapınma nesneleri, sahiplik ve tarihsel hizmet grubu adayları ise yalnızca aynı dinsel alana veya tekil örneklere temas ettiği için yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bu dalı yanlışın karşıtı olan doğruluk, gerçekliğe uygunluk, kesin olarak bilme ve sözün gerçek anlamında kullanılması çevresinde kurar. Verilen dal kimliği bu ortak çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kullanımlar doğruluk ve gerçekliğe uygunluk çekirdeğini taşır; yemin bildiren kalıp yalnız kendi söz dizimi içinde değerlendirilir ve dalın genel anlamına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşüncenin, sözün ya da durumun gerçekten var olana uygun düşmesi ve bu nedenle yanlışın karşısında doğru, sağlam ve kesin sayılmasıdır. Söz bakımından ayrıca eğretilemenin karşısındaki gerçek anlamı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gerçekte var olana uygun düşen şey doğru ve sağlamdır.
Bir konuyu araştırıp doğruluğundan kesin biçimde emin olma bu çekirdeğin bilgi alanındaki uzantısıdır.
Bir sözün eğretileme olmadan ilk konulduğu anlamda kullanılması, dil alanındaki özel görünümüdür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düşüncenin, sözün veya durumun gerçekten var olana uygun ve yanlışın karşıtı olduğunu bütün çekirdeğiyle anlatmak için kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin gerekli ve bağlayıcı hale gelmesini, bir kişinin ona layık ya da onunla yükümlü olmasını, ayrıca gerekli kılma ve hak etme işlemlerini birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu ilişkileri doğru toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir işin bağlayıcı biçimde gerekli olması veya bir sonucun kişiye düşmesidir; yalnızca doğru olma ya da özel mülkiyet payı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ve türemiş biçimler gereklilik ile hak edişi taşır; belirli ilgeç ve söz öbeklerine bağlı yönler kendi kalıplarında tutulur.

Bir şeyi gerekli kılmak ya da bir sonucu davranışla hak etmek, durumun ettirgen ve dönüşlü uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, gereklilik ve bağlayıcılığı kişi açısından layık olma, yükümlü tutulma, gerekli kılma ve bir sonucu hak etme yönleriyle bir araya getirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye ait olan özel istemi veya payı, bunun başkasına karşı ileri sürülmesini ve kişiye öncelik vermesini açıkça anlatır. Dal kimliği bu sahiplik ilişkisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu sözü Son Gün için özel bir ad olarak verir ve adlandırmayı bütün işlerin gerçekleşmesi, herkesin yaptığıyla yüzleşmesi ya da karşılığın kesinleşmesiyle açıklar. Dal çerçevesi bu özel göndermeyi doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel bitiş veya zorunluluk değil, yapılanların karşılığının kesinleştiği Son Gün için kullanılan özel bir addır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal tek başına kullanılan özel bir olay adını tanımlar; başka söz öbeklerindeki bitiş, doğruluk veya zorunluluk anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık adı Son Günle özdeşleştirir; gerekçe olarak işlerin gerçekleşmesi, kişinin yaptığıyla yüzleşmesi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesi biçiminde birbirini tamamlayan açıklamalar sunar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki söz burada soyut gerçeklik anlamına gelmez; kişinin koruması gereken şeyleri, ayrıca bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi somutlaşmış kullanımları gösterir. Bu nedenle dalın tanımı gerçeklikten korunması gereken sorumluluk alanına çevrilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, kişinin korumakla yükümlü olduğu şeydir; doğru olma veya sözün gerçek anlamı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Koruma yükümlülüğü yalın ad ve koruyucu kişi kalıbında görülür; bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi kullanımlar ayrı alt görünümler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin koruması, savunması ve çiğnetmemesi gereken şeylerin bütünüdür. Bayrak, dokunulmaz sayılan değer veya korunacak çevre bu sorumluluk alanını somutlaştırabilir.

facets.statement: Kişiye düşen görev, kendisine bağlı olan şeyi korumak ve savunmaktır.
Bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve korunacak çevre, bu koruma yükümlülüğünün adla gösterilen somut karşılıklarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, kişinin koruması gereken şeyi temel alır; bayrak, dokunulmaz sayılan değer ve çevreyi bu koruma sorumluluğunun farklı somut karşılıkları olarak sıralar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız dişi deveyi değil, üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına giren ve yük taşımaya elverişli hale gelen erkek ile dişi deveyi birlikte kapsar; ayrıca dişinin çiftleşme zamanını bildirir. Dal çerçevesindeki semirme bilgisi bu branch claim tarafından desteklenmez ve ayrı dalda yer alır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ana konusu belirli yaşa ulaşıp yük ve binme için elverişli olan devedir; çiftleşme zamanı kalıba bağlıdır, semirme ise dışarıda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yaş ve kullanıma elverişlilik erkek ve dişi adlarında korunur; dişinin çiftleşme zamanını bildiren söz öbeği ayrı bir kalıp olarak genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına girmiş ve yük taşımaya ya da binilmeye elverişli hale gelmiş erkek veya dişi devedir. Ayrı bir kalıp, dişi devenin çiftleşme için belirlenmiş zamanını anlatır.

facets.statement: Deve üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına girerek yük ve binme için elverişli hale gelir.
Yaş ve elverişlilik adı hem erkek hem dişi deve için cinsiyete göre ayrı biçimde kullanılır.
Dişi devenin erkek deveyle çiftleştirildiği belirli zaman, kalıba bağlı ayrı bir zaman kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, üç yaşını bitirip dördüncü yaşa giren devenin yük taşımaya elverişli sayılmasını temel alır; erkek ve dişi adlarını ve dişinin çiftleşme zamanını ayrıca belirtir.
